tickets.title: Prepare manual transfer package for joint taxable account
tickets.text: Prepare the manual transfer package for Lena and Colin Copperwisp's joint taxable account, preserving the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings from Silver Marmot Brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody after the automated request was rejected for an account number format mismatch.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that a manual package preserving the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings would be prepared, due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Resolve identity verification upload loop with Velvet Acorn Custody
tickets.text: Help resolve the repeated identity-verification upload loop with Velvet Acorn Custody for Lena Copperwisp's new receiving registration so she does not have to resubmit the same identification through the portal again.
tickets.evidence: Lena asked Apricot Compass Advisory to help resolve the repeated upload loop rather than asking her to resubmit the same identification through the portal again; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-07-31.

tickets.title: Confirm cost basis import treatment for Pocket Lantern Robotics shares
tickets.text: Coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody to confirm cost basis import treatment for the low-basis Pocket Lantern Robotics shares in Lena Copperwisp's joint taxable account so the transferred lots are not booked as unidentified positions.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody so the transferred lots are not booked as unidentified positions, due 2024-08-06.

tickets.title: Obtain trust certification for Copper Firefly Revocable Trust
tickets.text: Obtain an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document for the Copper Firefly Revocable Trust so Lena and Colin Copperwisp's joint taxable account registration can be finalized at Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian still needs an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document before the registration can be finalized; this remains needed, with a 2024-08-05 date.

tickets.title: Start Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA for Pocket Lantern 401(k)
tickets.text: Start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup for Lena Copperwisp and coordinate direct-rollover instructions for her Pocket Lantern Robotics 401(k) (approximately $612,000) once plan access is confirmed.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup and coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed, due 2024-08-09.

tickets.title: Reconcile owner name mismatch on Colin's inherited IRA
tickets.text: Reconcile the owner name mismatch on Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA (approximately $166,000) between Silver Marmot Brokerage and the draft receiving paperwork at Velvet Acorn Custody before submitting another transfer request so the inherited IRA registration is not rejected.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the titling before submitting another transfer request so the inherited IRA registration is not rejected, due 2024-08-07.

tickets.title: Obtain most recent statement for Colin's inherited IRA
tickets.text: Obtain the most recent statement for Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA (approximately $166,000) at Silver Marmot Brokerage showing the inherited IRA registration for the receiving custodian, since online access did not display the needed document during the call.
tickets.evidence: obtaining the statement remains needed, with a 2024-08-04 date.

tickets.title: Track transfer sequence before Silver Marmot fee increase
tickets.text: Track the transfer sequence for Lena and Colin Copperwisp's main household accounts against the client-imposed timing target to complete the move from Silver Marmot Brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody before the prior custodian's announced household service fee increase.
tickets.evidence: they agreed to track the transfer sequence against that client-imposed timing target, due 2024-08-23.
